takeaways.text: Any contact is an incident: stop, check, and report it. Slow down near obstacles and use your mirrors.
Reverse slowly. Watch the rear camera and both mirrors, and stop at once if anything is close. Get out and look when you cannot see.

checks.label: Got out and looked before reversing into a tight space
checks.lesson: G.O.A.L.: get out and look when the space is tight. The camera has blind spots too.

checks.label: Looked in the mirrors before moving
checks.lesson: Look at the mirror for the side you are moving to, then signal, then go. Vans have blind spots a car does not.
